tools.name: overview
tools.description: The Agentic Engineering Periodic System: what it is, how to read it (rows, columns, judging and reading rules), the roles. Call this first.

tools.name: find_elements
tools.description: Find elements of the table by words in their name, problem or test, by role (dev, lead, plat, qa, ...), by group (security, verification, ...) or by row (task, change, system, organisation). Returns one line per element.

tools.name: get_element
tools.description: One element in full: problem, observable test with its clauses and evidence kinds, when it applies, when it adds work without helping, activities, relations, page link. By ID (ae-006), symbol (Sx) or name.

tools.name: repository_checklist
tools.description: What a repository can show for each test, clause by clause, what it cannot, and the judging rules. Use it to check the current project; read the files yourself. Optional: element IDs, a role or a group to narrow it.
